content.comment_body: How can we download [product_name] [version_no]? I am experiencing the same issue with [product_name] [version_no], and there is a different problem with [product_name] [version_no] related to TOMCAT version. [user_name]

Based on my knowledge, [product_name] [version_no] can only be downloaded along with [product_name] [version_no]. The download for [product_name] [version_no] has been removed because a newer version was released. To obtain it now, you need to submit a support request.

According to [company_name] Support: [user_name], [product_name] [version_no] was provided together with [product_name] [version_no]. Since [product_name] [version_no] is quite new, it's possible that DVDs with [product_name] [version_no] are still available in stores. However, [company_name] can't offer it anymore due to third-party licensing constraints. The only solution offered is to forward the issue regarding [product_name] [version_no] to the development team, as it requires all features from previous versions. [product_name] [version_no] is no longer available.
